req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint replaces an existing player. Key branches: (1) happy path returns 204, (2) squad_number mismatch returns 400, (3) non-existent squad_number returns 404, (4) missing required fields returns 422. The service layer has a known bug: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit (no SQLAlchemyError path), so the route raises 500. Tests must cover exact status codes, body/path mismatch, boundary squad numbers (1 = lowest seeded, 26 = highest seeded, 27 = just above), and state transitions (create then update). Mutation targets: status code constants (204 vs 200/201/400/404/422/500), comparison operators in squad_number mismatch check, boolean returns in service layer.

tests.name: test_put_player_valid_body_matching_id_returns_204
preconditions: Database contains player with squadNumber=10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid PlayerRequestModel body where squad_number=10
trace: R-PLAYER-010: system shall replace existing player on PUT with valid body and matching ID
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_put_player_valid_body_matching_id_returns_204():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy-Updated",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 204
    assert response.content == b""

test_put_player_valid_body_matching_id_returns_204()

tests.name: test_put_player_state_transition_create_then_update_returns_204
preconditions: Database does NOT contain a player with squadNumber=50
actions: POST /players/ to create player with squadNumber=50
PUT /players/squadnumber/50 to update the newly created player
trace: R-PLAYER-010: system shall replace existing player; STC covers non-existent->created->updated states
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_put_player_state_transition_create_then_update_returns_204():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    post_response = client.post("/players/", json=create_payload)
    assert post_response.status_code == 201
    update_payload = {
        "firstName": "Test-Updated",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Player-Updated",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "CB",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    put_response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/50", json=update_payload)
    assert put_response.status_code == 204
    assert put_response.content == b""

test_put_player_state_transition_create_then_update_returns_204()
